name: grafana_api_call
description: Call the Grafana HTTP API. Reads (GET, /api/ds/query)=low; create/update dashboard or folder=medium; delete=high. Rooted at the configured instance URL; pass paths under /api/...

function.name: grafana_api_call
function.description:
Call the Grafana HTTP API (rooted at the configured instance URL).

Auth (a service-account/API token) is already configured — do NOT log in or use requests. The token needs Editor/Admin scope to create dashboards.

RETURN VALUE: a JSON string; json.loads it -> {"status_code", "data", "error", "blast_radius"}. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.

READ ENDPOINTS:
  GET  /api/health                     Instance health (no auth) (low)
  GET  /api/search?type=dash-db        Search dashboards; data is a list of {uid,title,tags} (low)
  GET  /api/search?query=<q>&tag=<t>   Filter dashboards by title/tag (low)
  GET  /api/dashboards/uid/{uid}       Full dashboard model (low)
  GET  /api/datasources                List data sources; each {uid,name,type} (low)
  GET  /api/datasources/uid/{uid}      Data source detail (low)
  POST /api/ds/query                   Query through a datasource proxy (READ, low)
    Body: {"queries": [{"refId": "A", "expr": "<promql>", "datasource": {"uid": "<ds_uid>"}, "instant": true}]}
  GET  /api/org                        Current org (low)
  GET  /api/user                       Current user (validates the token) (low)

WRITE ENDPOINTS (blast radius medium/high — pause for approval; state the change first):
  POST   /api/dashboards/db            Create or update a dashboard (medium)
    Body: {"dashboard": <model>, "folderUid": <opt>, "overwrite": false, "message": <opt>}
    <model> = {"title": ..., "time": {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}, "templating": {"list": []}, "panels": [<panel>...]}. Omit id/uid to create; set an existing uid + overwrite=true to update.
    <panel> = {"type": "timeseries"|"stat"|"gauge"|"piechart"|"table", "title": ..., "datasource": {"uid": <ds_uid>}, "targets": [{"refId":"A","expr":"<promql>"}], "gridPos": {"h":8,"w":12,"x":0,"y":0}}. Get ds_uid from GET /api/datasources.
  POST   /api/folders                  Create a folder (medium). Body: {"title": ..., "uid": <opt>}
  DELETE /api/dashboards/uid/{uid}     Delete a dashboard (high)

BUILD FLOW: (1) GET /api/datasources -> pick a prometheus uid; (2) assemble the dashboard model with panels wired to that uid; (3) POST /api/dashboards/db. Response data = {uid, url, status:"success"}.

NOTES: self-signed certs are controlled by the Verify SSL toggle in Settings -> Grafana. On 401, the token is wrong or lacks scope; on 403 the token lacks write permission.

query_params.description: URL query parameters as key-value pairs (optional, e.g. {"type": "dash-db", "query": "wan"})
